Everything seems to be piling up."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It’s okay to have all these emotions. You've been through a lot recently. How are you managing to cope with everything?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Well, I'm trying to stick to some of the things my therapist suggested, like journaling and mindfulness exercises, but sometimes it feels like I’m just going through the motions."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Journaling and mindfulness can be great tools, but it’s also okay to not have it all figured out right now.
